get.summary:
Read model for the dedicated global server asset page. This intentionally
derives deployment and project counts from the latest retained evidence or
projection snapshot; it does not create a second ownership model for HOST.

provider_kinds.description: Optional provider selection. An empty list keeps the legacy automatic selection.

requested_capabilities.description: Capability hints are advisory; the server validates every adapter.

root_refs.description: User-confirmed roots are bounded inputs for non-Docker providers.

unknown_count.description:
Includes explicit unknown evaluations and scheduled slots with no
evaluation. `gap_count` identifies the latter subset.

oneOf.description:
Present only for compacted hour/day points. Raw point JSON remains
backward-compatible and omits this field.

value_integer.description:
Exact decimal representation for INTEGER counter samples. `value`
remains available for charting, but may round values above JavaScript's
safe-integer range.

counter_delta_integer.description: Exact decimal counter delta. Gauge and derived rollups leave this null.

project_target_id.description:
Every target-scoped tool must receive this stable binding explicitly.
`list_project_targets` is the sole project-scoped exception.
